estimate_source_note: T_total from response.usage (prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, cached_tokens); logical char4 recorded separately — never mixed into T_total

provider.name: z.ai
provider.model_rationale: Documented cheap/flash model on Z.ai paas/v4 chat-completion enum (docs.z.ai); prefer over larger glm-4.5 / glm-5.x for pilot cost
provider.thinking_note: Disable Z.ai GLM thinking so answers land in message.content; empty content + T_completion=max_tokens was the BITE-15b stop confounder

retry.note: On TimeoutError / URL read timeout: sleep base * factor^attempt between tries (2s, 4s, 8s) then fail that call; checkpoint status=timeout. HTTP 429 is NEVER retried — immediate stop + flush partial/checkpoint (decision pivot / rate_limit_partial).

checkpoint.resume_policy: skip ok (no duplicate billing); retry prior timeout/error once under this run's retry budget; skip prior rate_limit keys (avoid 429 storm)

minimal.rationale: Cost control for first billed smoke; expand toward N_pilot=24/family later via --n-per-family / --families

decision.rate_limit_partial: pivot or insufficient_offline with reason rate_limit_partial
